mapper.select: SELECT faq_no AS faqNo, category, question, answer, sort_order AS sortOrder, delete_yn AS deleteYn, created_at AS createdAt FROM faq WHERE delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY category, sort_order ASC

SELECT faq_no AS faqNo, category, question, answer, sort_order AS sortOrder, delete_yn AS deleteYn, created_at AS createdAt FROM faq WHERE delete_yn = 'N' AND category = #{category} ORDER BY sort_order ASC

SELECT faq_no AS faqNo, category, question, answer, sort_order AS sortOrder, delete_yn AS deleteYn, created_at AS createdAt FROM faq WHERE delete_yn = 'N' AND (question LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR answer LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%') ORDER BY category, sort_order ASC
